result.summary: Gross margin fell $56.7K (8.4%) in September versus August. Rain Jacket drove the decline asa real driver (lift 3.03), dominated by a 19.97% unit cost surge adding ~$28.2K pressure while units fell 3.34% and price dropped 0.18%; Air Purifier and Coffee Maker contributed proportional declines (lift 0.87 and 0.64) driven by volume and unit cost effects respectively. Channel and region effects were ruled out as proportional or diffuse, and the USD/CAD rate edged up 0.27%, too small to explain the move, serving only as correlation context.

claims.statement: Rain Jacket contributed a $33.0K margin decline (lift 3.03, 58% of total drop), drivenby a 19.97% unit cost surge adding -$28.2K pressure while units fell 3.34% (-$4.3K) and price dropped 0.18% (-$0.5K), making unit cost the dominant effect.

Air Purifier contributed a $11.5K margin decline (lift 0.87, proportional mover), withunit cost rising 1.36% (-$4.1K), units falling 4.77% (-$7.5K) and price changing +0.04% (+$0.2K); the volumeeffect dominated the delta.

Coffee Maker contributed a $5.2K margin decline (lift 0.64, proportional mover), with unit cost rising 1.84% (-$2.5K), units falling 2.03% (-$2.0K) and price dropping 0.31% (-$0.7K); both unit cost and volume contributed.

ruled_out.why: proportional: 'Online' holds 42% of the change but its size alone predicts that (lift 0.94)
diffuse: largest same-direction member 'Quebec' holds 40% of the scope change
proportional: 'Online' holds 44% of the change but its size alone predicts that (lift 0.96)

caveats: The decomposition shows which segments moved and by how much; it cannot identify business causes (pricing, campaigns, supply) that are not in the data.
